$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the website menu. Every item with "price": null renders as 'Price TBC' on the site — search this file for `null` to find what still needs real numbers. Items flagged "needsReview": true have a description drafted from the old site's marketing copy rather than confirmed by the kitchen. Once Genius POS credentials exist, `npm run sync:menu` in worker/ can repopulate `posId` and prices from the POS item catalog (see docs/GENIUS-POS.md).
